resources.string: Select the data you want to export, save it locally or transfer to another device
Import data from a backup file, merged by contact name without overwriting existing data

💡 Notes:
• Backup files are password-protected — keep your password safe
• You can select contacts when exporting
• Backups include all chat fields (text, images, voice)
• Imports are merged by contact name and never overwrite existing data
• Export regularly to prevent data loss
